evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce COPEX (COntext Provider EXploitation), a controlled benchmark that isolates the model as an MCP client by fixing the surrounding agent stack and varying only the tool-selecting model.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models increasingly mediate tool use in Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, where adversarial influence may enter through user instructions, tool schemas, tool outputs, or protocol messages.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across nine models and 3,375 trials, the mean attack success rate is 64.4%, with surface-level means ranging from 58.3% to 71.4%.
